artifacts.claim_boundary: This witness binds the immutable target-owned native receipt to its exact run, checks, and non-calibration native obligations.

claim_boundary: SkillGuard supervises the complete native kb-organization-contribute maintenance unit, its target-specific obligations, and the sole current enforced closure. It does not ship with or execute on the consumer machine.

depth_profile.claim_boundary: Only exact current receipts for the target skill's declared checks are supervised. The target skill retains all domain judgment, including positive/shallow behavior and direct native completion.

functions.business_intent: Run as the unscheduled organization-cycle child and contribute only policy-eligible, privacy-safe, content-hash-bound current organization knowledge.
functions.signature: Input x State -> Set(Output x State)

obligations.description: Treat missing or invalid organization settings as a receipt-backed successful no-op.
Sync the validated organization mirror and run organization preflight before export.
Export only shareable public models and exclude private or machine-specific material before any branch or push.
Block every previously exchanged or currently present content hash.
Bundle dependent Skills with hash, author, version, and original-author update policy.
Use the import branch, push/PR path, and auto-merge label only when checks allow.
Record postflight and return a complete created/skipped/error receipt.
Close the lane correctly and surface errors without partial success claims.
Keep contribution native and owner timeouts strictly below aggregate and installer owners, and prove zero descendants after any timeout.
Reject shallow outbox-only completion and require the full native receipt.

action.summary: Load the target-owned inputs and prove every intake obligation before mutation.
Run the native maintenance owner through every declared execution branch.
Require the current terminal receipt plus positive and shallow target-owned checks before closure.
